bridge.scope: Signed payment-webhook delivery and replay-protection regression

environment.description: Independent VPS rerun of the signed payment-webhook regression against the relevant MyZubster component

steps: Generate an HMAC-SHA256 signed webhook event.
Verify the delivery ID remains stable across retry.
Verify replay protection accepts a delivery claim only once.

observation.summary: The independently reproduced signed payment-webhook regression passed all five targeted cases.
outputs: stable delivery ID on retry verified

limitations: This checkpoint is bounded to the signed webhook regression.
It does not establish external receiver deployment or end-to-end settlement.
It does not establish wallet security or broader platform security.
